verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration-filing SaaS, so offering an API with scoped agent credentials is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has no API, token or permission-scoping documentation, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. With no evidence the product issues least-privilege credentials, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
